assumptions.name: mem_scope_job_total
assumptions.statement: TRESReq_mem is the job's total requested memory, not per node or per CPU. Slurm's convention for ReqTRES; not checked against this cluster's configuration. Adopted by Glen, 2026-10-07.

assumptions.name: mem_units_binary
assumptions.statement: The suffixes M, G and T are powers of 1024: 2^20, 2^30 and 2^40 bytes. Slurm's convention; not checked against this cluster's configuration. Adopted by Glen, 2026-10-07.

flags.tres_unrecorded: TRES request fields were not recorded for this job (TRESReq_mem empty or null; every job before 22 January 2026). GPU, node and memory requests are unknown, not zero.
flags.mem_special: TRESReq_mem is zero, Slurm's request for all of a node's memory. Kept raw; no byte value is derived.
flags.mem_invalid: TRESReq_mem is not a number followed by M, G or T.
flags.mem_scope_assumed_job_total: req_mem_bytes rests on the assumptions mem_scope_job_total and mem_units_binary.
flags.walltime_partition_default: TimelimitRaw is Partition: the partition's default limit applied, and its value is not recorded.
flags.walltime_invalid: TimelimitRaw is not a whole number of minutes, UNLIMITED or Partition.
flags.jobid_malformed: JobID is neither a plain number nor <parent>_<index>.
flags.partition_unresolved: partition contains '_': an unstarted multi-partition request recorded as the list it asked for.
flags.nodes_missing: TRES was recorded but TRESReq_node is empty or null.
flags.nodes_invalid: TRESReq_node is not a whole number.
flags.gpus_invalid: TRESReq_gres_gpu is not a whole number.

fields.name: array_parent_id
fields.rule: The digits before '_' when JobID is <parent>_<index>; null for a plain JobID; null with jobid_malformed otherwise.

fields.name: array_task_index
fields.rule: The digits after '_' when JobID is <parent>_<index>; null for a plain JobID; null with jobid_malformed otherwise.

fields.name: researcher_key
fields.rule: Pseudonymous identity: 'r_' and the first 16 hex characters of HMAC-SHA256(salt, netid), stable across exports while the salt is unchanged. With identity 'netid' (caller needs the identify permission), the netid verbatim. Null with netid_missing when netid is empty or null.

fields.name: account
fields.rule: Verbatim. The Unix group of the submitting account, which is not necessarily a Slurm account.

fields.name: submit_local
fields.rule: RFC 3339 with offset, in the request's time zone, computed by the exporter (not the database).

fields.name: submit_month
fields.rule: YYYY-MM in the request's time zone, computed by the exporter.

fields.name: partition_raw
fields.rule: Verbatim, including multi-partition values. partition_unresolved when it contains '_'; partition_missing when empty or null.

fields.name: state
fields.rule: Verbatim. Never used to select rows: every job submitted in the window is exported.

fields.name: req_cpus
fields.rule: ReqCPUS verbatim. cpu_tres_mismatch when TRESReq_cpu is present and differs; cpus_missing when ReqCPUS is null.

fields.name: req_nodes
fields.rule: TRESReq_node as a whole number. Never NNodes, which is nodes allocated. Null with tres_unrecorded when TRES was not recorded; null with nodes_missing or nodes_invalid otherwise.

fields.name: req_gpus
fields.rule: TRESReq_gres_gpu as a whole number. 0 only when TRES was recorded and TRESReq_gres_gpu is empty or null. Null with tres_unrecorded when TRES was not recorded; null with gpus_invalid when not a whole number.

fields.name: req_mem_bytes
fields.rule: Number times 2^20 (M), 2^30 (G) or 2^40 (T), rounded to the nearest byte, with mem_scope_assumed_job_total. Null with mem_missing, mem_special (zero) or mem_invalid otherwise.

fields.name: req_walltime_s
fields.rule: Whole minutes times 60. Null with walltime_unlimited, walltime_partition_default, walltime_missing or walltime_invalid otherwise; the four stay distinct.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.rule: Every flag that applies to the row's delivered fields, sorted and joined with ';'; empty when none apply.

fields.name: req_gpu_type
fields.reason: TRESReq_gres_gpu holds a GPU count only; no column records the requested GPU model.

fields.name: req_mem_scope_requested
fields.reason: Whether memory was requested per node (--mem) or per CPU (--mem-per-cpu) is not stored; TRESReq_mem holds one value. See the assumption mem_scope_job_total.

fields.name: req_nodes_range
fields.reason: TRESReq_node holds a single count; a requested range such as 2-4 is not stored.
